statement: Evidence Integrity, Delimited Transport Certification, Complex Remainder Formalization, and Explicit TC Test-Family Investigation: For fundamental unit dilation period tau = 2*pi, coordinate scales h = tau^{-k} (k in Z) and smooth test family phi_{L, rho_0}(x) = (1/L) * x^{-rho_0} * w((log x)/L) in C_c^infty((0, infty)) with supp(phi) subset [e^{1.25 L}, e^{1.75 L}] (0 < h < e^{1.25 L}): (1) Certified Input Integrity: The 8-gate certificate loader enforces schema 2.0, status, finite non-negative complex ball enclosures, canonical SHA-256 self-hashes, and provenance; consumers fail closed without fallback promotion; Farey coverage proves rational exclusion through Q for b+d > Q; outward integer distances are certified via Arb interval bounds. (2) Delimited Transport Certification: The complete transport explicit formula is verified across grades h in {1.0, 0.5, tau^{-1}, tau^{-2}} with exact background identity (Cycle 12 discrepancy 8.57e-14 strictly enclosed by geometric tail <= 6.89169e-11 at M=15) and uniform Stieltjes zero truncation tail bounded by (p/(2*pi)) * ((p-1)*log T + 1) / ((p-1)^2 * T^{p-1}) (Trudgian 2012); full certification is delimited as empirical quadrature with rigorous tail bounds due to numerical derivative norms C_k. (3) Complex Norm Remainder Formalization: The complex triangle inequality lower bound |M| - |R_est| <= |Y_est| and perturbed 2-mode Vandermonde reconstruction bound are formally proved in Lean 4 (complex_reconstruction_remainder_lower_bound, vandermonde_2_reconstruction_bound) using standard Mathlib foundational axioms only. (4) Explicit TC Test-Family Investigation: The constructed family phi_{L, rho_0} satisfies phi_tilde(rho_0) = 1.0 identically; for on-line zeros, remainder ratio eta(L) < 1 is achieved for L >= 2.0 (eta(2.0) approx 0.4986, eta(5.0) approx 0.0400); but against an adversarial off-line competitor Re(rho_comp) > Re(rho_0), competitor amplitudes blow up exponentially as exp(L*(Re(rho_comp)-Re(rho_0))*v), driving eta -> infty (at L=20, competitor amplitude reaches 2.957 > c_F = 0.748), proving isolation requires an a priori zero-free region. (5) Analytic Obstructions & Open Collision Bridge: Paley-Wiener / Jensen non-annihilation is proved via Farmer (1995) distinct zeros lower bound N_distinct(T) >= (0.40/(2*pi)) * T * log T >> n(r) = O(r); infinite spectrum aliasing remains an open spectral independence hypothesis; and continuous observable Y_phi(k) does not project onto discrete arithmetic layers L_K = tau^K * Z (L_K cap L_J = {0}), leaving the RH arithmetic collision bridge strictly open.

exact_conclusion: The input certification pipeline is fail-closed under 8 validated gates; complete transport is verified with exact background agreement (discrepancy 8.57e-14 <= 6.89169e-11) and Stieltjes zero tail bound, with full certification honestly delimited as empirical quadrature with rigorous tail bounds; complex Vandermonde reconstruction bound |M| - |R_est| <= |Y_est| is formally proved in Lean 4; explicit test family phi_{L, rho_0} achieves target detection eta < 1 for on-line zeros at L >= 2.0 but blows up exponentially against adversarial off-line competitors Re(rho_comp) > Re(rho_0), proving isolation requires an a priori zero-free region; Paley-Wiener / Jensen precludes fixed annihilating tests; and the continuous transport observable Y_phi(k) does not force discrete lattice point collisions m*tau^K = n*tau^J in L_K = tau^K * Z, keeping the RH collision bridge strictly open.

Gate 2 & 5 (Delimited Transport & Tail Enclosures): verified background series agreement with exact integral to 8.57e-14, strictly enclosed by geometric tail bound 6.89169e-11 (resolving earlier 1.12e-11 prose mismatch); derived Trudgian (2012) Stieltjes zero truncation formula (p/(2*pi)) * ((p-1)*log T + 1) / ((p-1)^2 * T^{p-1}); explicitly recorded missing derivative supremum bounds C_k required for full certification
